rationale: The agent authenticated the user via name and ZIP and looked up user and order details, and it acted on the correct order (#W9502127). However, it executed a return (return_delivered_order_items) without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, which violates the policy. Additionally, the user explicitly asked for the total refund amount expected; the agent did not provide this figure, only the refund timeline and the amounts for remaining items. While the agent correctly refused to expedite beyond policy and provided totals for remaining items, the missing confirmation before the write and the lack of the refund total mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
